## Introduction

The aim of this package is to represent phylogenetic trees in real continuous space.

## Dependencies

This package depends on [Stan](https://mc-stan.org/) through CmdStan. Although [other options might exist](https://mc-stan.org/docs/cmdstan-guide/cmdstan-installation.html), for instance using Conda, the simplest option is to install CmdStan via the R package [CmdStanR](https://mc-stan.org/cmdstanr/). You can do so with the commands
```{r eval = FALSE}
install.packages("cmdstanr", repos = c("https://mc-stan.org/r-packages/", getOption("repos")))
cmdstanr::install_cmdstan()
```
The last command will download and compile all the required dependencies.

## Installation

You can install ContPhylo from github with:

```{r gh-installation, eval = FALSE}
devtools::install_github("xavierdidelot/ContPhylo")
```

The package can then be loaded using:
```{r}
library(ContPhylo,quietly=T)
```
